image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked meatloaf resting in a metallic baking pan. The loaf is oblong with a browned, textured exterior crust and a visible cross-section at the front end showing a dense, pinkish-brown interior with flecks of ingredients. A glossy, reddish glaze coats parts of the surface. The background is a stark white void, suggesting a cutout or studio isolation.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the metal pan
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rim of the metal pan on the left side dissolves into the white background with no clear boundary or thickness. It appears to melt or fade away rather than ending abruptly, which is physically impossible for a rigid metal object.
The perspective of the pan is inconsistent. The right side shows a clear vertical wall and depth, while the left side lacks definition and seems to flatten out, creating a spatial contradiction.
The texture of the meatloaf is slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth in certain mid-tone areas, lacking the granular detail expected in high-resolution food photography, though not severely distorted.
